choose.when: INSERT INTO work_detail(revision_id,body_markdown,demo_url,source_url,project_status,tech_stack) VALUES(#{id},#{input.bodyMarkdown},#{input.details.demoUrl},#{input.details.sourceUrl},#{input.details.projectStatus}, ARRAY[#{tech}]::text[]) ON CONFLICT(revision_id) DO UPDATE SET body_markdown=EXCLUDED.body_markdown,demo_url=EXCLUDED.demo_url,source_url=EXCLUDED.source_url,project_status=EXCLUDED.project_status,tech_stack=EXCLUDED.tech_stack

INSERT INTO tutorial_detail(revision_id,intro_markdown,difficulty,prerequisites_markdown) VALUES(#{id},#{input.bodyMarkdown},#{input.details.difficulty},#{input.details.prerequisitesMarkdown}) ON CONFLICT(revision_id) DO UPDATE SET intro_markdown=EXCLUDED.intro_markdown,difficulty=EXCLUDED.difficulty,prerequisites_markdown=EXCLUDED.prerequisites_markdown

INSERT INTO website_detail(revision_id,website_url,description_markdown,icon_asset_id) VALUES(#{id},#{input.details.websiteUrl},#{input.bodyMarkdown},#{input.details.iconAssetId}) ON CONFLICT(revision_id) DO UPDATE SET website_url=EXCLUDED.website_url,description_markdown=EXCLUDED.description_markdown,icon_asset_id=EXCLUDED.icon_asset_id

INSERT INTO deal_detail(revision_id,body_markdown,source_url,claim_url,benefit_text,requirements_markdown,starts_at,ends_at) VALUES(#{id},#{input.bodyMarkdown},#{input.details.sourceUrl},#{input.details.claimUrl},#{input.details.benefitText},#{input.details.requirementsMarkdown},#{input.details.startsAt},#{input.details.endsAt}) ON CONFLICT(revision_id) DO UPDATE SET body_markdown=EXCLUDED.body_markdown,source_url=EXCLUDED.source_url,claim_url=EXCLUDED.claim_url,benefit_text=EXCLUDED.benefit_text,requirements_markdown=EXCLUDED.requirements_markdown,starts_at=EXCLUDED.starts_at,ends_at=EXCLUDED.ends_at
choose.otherwise: INSERT INTO article_detail(revision_id,body_markdown) VALUES(#{id},#{input.bodyMarkdown}) ON CONFLICT(revision_id) DO UPDATE SET body_markdown=EXCLUDED.body_markdown
